args.summary: v2.3.1 deployed to all production regions and immediately began failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Rolled back to v2.3.0 (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback verification: all regions healthy on v2.3.0, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions. Verified post-rollback: all regions healthy, error rate dropped to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback, and verification results. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so re-deploying it (or any fix based on it) will require change-manager approval under the org policy.
